_note: Plain-language messages (M11). engine = mfengine.RejectReason, admin = mfengine.AdminRejectReason, cancel = mfengine.CancelReason, api = services.api.app.ERROR_CODES. tests/services/test_dashboard_content.py checks every code is here and nothing else.

INVALID_PRICE.title: That price can't be used
INVALID_PRICE.message: A limit order needs a price above zero, and a market order must not have one.
INVALID_PRICE.fix: Enter a positive price, or switch to a market order to trade at the best available prices.

INVALID_QTY.title: That quantity can't be used
INVALID_QTY.message: The quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
INVALID_QTY.fix: Enter how many shares you want, for example 10.

INVALID_ORDER_TYPE.title: Those options don't go together
INVALID_ORDER_TYPE.message: A market order must be immediate-or-cancel, and post-only works only on a limit order that can rest in the book.
INVALID_ORDER_TYPE.fix: Use a limit order with Good till cancelled or Day for post-only, or drop post-only.

DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID.title: This order was already sent
DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID.message: The exchange has already accepted an order with this id today.
DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID.fix: Place the order again: the dashboard gives each new order a fresh id.

UNKNOWN_ORDER.title: That order is no longer open
UNKNOWN_ORDER.message: It has already been filled or cancelled, so there is nothing left to change.
UNKNOWN_ORDER.fix: Refresh your open orders; it may have traded a moment ago.

NO_LIQUIDITY.title: Nobody is on the other side
NO_LIQUIDITY.message: A market order needs at least one resting order to trade against, and there are none.
NO_LIQUIDITY.fix: Use a limit order at the price you want; it will wait in the book.

FOK_NOT_FILLABLE.title: It couldn't fill completely, so nothing traded
FOK_NOT_FILLABLE.message: Fill-or-kill trades the whole quantity at once or not at all, and there isn't enough at your price.
FOK_NOT_FILLABLE.fix: Lower the quantity, improve the price, or use Immediate or cancel to take what is there.

POST_ONLY_WOULD_CROSS.title: It would have traded immediately
POST_ONLY_WOULD_CROSS.message: Post-only orders only add to the book; at this price it would have matched a resting order.
POST_ONLY_WOULD_CROSS.fix: Move the price away from the other side (lower for a buy, higher for a sell), or turn post-only off.

REPLACE_QTY_TOO_LOW.title: The new quantity is too small
REPLACE_QTY_TOO_LOW.message: When you change an order, the new quantity counts what has already filled and must be more than that.
REPLACE_QTY_TOO_LOW.fix: Enter a total quantity above the filled amount, or cancel the order instead.

MARKET_CLOSED.title: The market isn't open
MARKET_CLOSED.message: This symbol is not in continuous trading right now (pre-open, halted or closed).
MARKET_CLOSED.fix: Try again when the session is open; the status strip shows the market state.

KILL_SWITCH.title: Trading is switched off
KILL_SWITCH.message: An exchange operator has engaged a kill switch for this account or for everyone.
KILL_SWITCH.fix: Nothing to change on your side: trading resumes when the switch is released.

RATE_LIMIT.title: Too many orders at once
RATE_LIMIT.message: This account sent orders faster than its rate limit allows.
RATE_LIMIT.fix: Wait a second and try again.

MAX_QTY.title: That quantity is above the limit
MAX_QTY.message: Each order on this symbol is limited to a maximum number of shares.

PRICE_BAND.title: That price is too far from the market
PRICE_BAND.message: The exchange refuses prices outside a band around the reference price, to catch typos.
PRICE_BAND.fix: Use a price closer to the current market.

MAX_NOTIONAL.title: The order is too large in value
MAX_NOTIONAL.message: Price times quantity is above this account's per-order limit.
MAX_NOTIONAL.fix: Lower the quantity or the price.

MAX_OPEN_ORDERS.title: Too many open orders
MAX_OPEN_ORDERS.message: This account already has as many resting orders as it is allowed.

POSITION_LIMIT.title: It could take your position past its limit
POSITION_LIMIT.message: Counting your open orders, this order could leave you holding more shares (long or short) than allowed.
POSITION_LIMIT.fix: Lower the quantity or cancel open orders on the same side.

INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT.title: Not enough credit
INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT.message: Your open orders plus this one would exceed the account's credit limit.
INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT.fix: Cancel open orders or place a smaller order.

INVALID_TRANSITION.title: That session change isn't allowed
INVALID_TRANSITION.message: The market can't move from its current state to the requested one.
INVALID_TRANSITION.fix: Check the current session state and choose a valid next state.

INVALID_LIMITS.title: Those limits are out of range
INVALID_LIMITS.message: One of the risk limits is outside its allowed range.
INVALID_LIMITS.fix: See docs/risk.md for the ranges and try again.

INVALID_KILL_SWITCH.title: That kill-switch change isn't allowed
INVALID_KILL_SWITCH.message: The switch is already in that state, or the request names no valid target.
INVALID_KILL_SWITCH.fix: Check the current state of the switch.

UNFILLED.title: The rest was cancelled
UNFILLED.message: Immediate-or-cancel and market orders never wait: whatever didn't fill straight away was cancelled.
UNFILLED.fix: Use Good till cancelled to leave the rest in the book.

SELF_TRADE.title: Stopped from trading with yourself
SELF_TRADE.message: The order would have matched one of your own resting orders, so the exchange cancelled it.
SELF_TRADE.fix: Cancel your own order on the other side first.

EXPIRED.title: Expired at the close
EXPIRED.message: A Day order is cancelled when the session closes.
EXPIRED.fix: Use Good till cancelled to keep it across sessions.

KILL_SWITCH.title: Cancelled by the kill switch
KILL_SWITCH.message: An operator switched trading off and cancelled open orders.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: You need a practice account
UNAUTHORIZED.message: Trading needs an API key, and there isn't a valid one in this tab.
UNAUTHORIZED.fix: Click Try trading to get a practice account, or paste an API key.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not allowed for this account
FORBIDDEN.message: This account isn't allowed to do that (admin commands, or a raw backtest config from a practice account).
FORBIDDEN.fix: Use the backtest form, or an account with the right role.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.message: That item doesn't exist, or belongs to another account.
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the link, or go back to the list.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Not supported
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.message: The server doesn't support that request.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Reload the page; if it keeps happening, it is a bug.

HTTP_ERROR.title: Request failed
HTTP_ERROR.fix: Reload the page and try again.

BAD_REQUEST.title: Request not understood
BAD_REQUEST.message: The server couldn't read the request.
BAD_REQUEST.fix: Reload the page and try again.

VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Something in the form needs fixing
VALIDATION_ERROR.message: One or more fields aren't valid.

UNKNOWN_SYMBOL.title: Unknown symbol
UNKNOWN_SYMBOL.message: This exchange doesn't list that symbol.
UNKNOWN_SYMBOL.fix: Choose one of the listed symbols.

ORDER_REJECTED.title: The exchange rejected the order
ORDER_REJECTED.message: The order didn't pass the exchange's checks.

ADMIN_REJECTED.title: The exchange rejected the change
ADMIN_REJECTED.message: The admin command didn't pass the exchange's checks.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.title: That request id was used for something else
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.message: A retried request must be identical to the original.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.fix: Place the order again as a new order.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Slow down a little
RATE_LIMITED.message: Too many requests from this account in one second.
RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait a moment and try again.

PRACTICE_LIMIT.title: Too many practice accounts
PRACTICE_LIMIT.message: Only a few practice accounts can be created from one address each hour.
PRACTICE_LIMIT.fix: Use the practice account you already have, or try again later.

BACKTEST_LIMIT.title: You have backtests running
BACKTEST_LIMIT.message: A practice account can have only a couple of backtests queued or running at once.
BACKTEST_LIMIT.fix: Wait for one to finish (its page shows progress), then start another.

SYMBOL_HALTED.title: Trading in this symbol is halted
SYMBOL_HALTED.message: The exchange stopped this symbol after an internal error.
SYMBOL_HALTED.fix: Try another symbol; an operator has to restart this one.

ENGINE_FAILED.title: The exchange hit an internal error
ENGINE_FAILED.message: This symbol's engine failed and was halted to protect its data.

EXPIRED.title: The request took too long
EXPIRED.message: It reached the exchange after its deadline, so it was not processed.

MATCHER_TIMEOUT.title: No answer in time
MATCHER_TIMEOUT.message: The exchange didn't reply in time, so it's unknown whether the order went through.
MATCHER_TIMEOUT.fix: Check your open orders before trying again.

PROJECTION_LAGGING.title: Your history is catching up
PROJECTION_LAGGING.message: The database behind your order history is a moment behind the exchange.

BOOK_UNAVAILABLE.title: No market data yet
BOOK_UNAVAILABLE.message: The exchange hasn't published this symbol's book yet.
BOOK_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Wait a few seconds; the page reconnects by itself.

CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.title: Backtest data isn't ready
CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.message: The backtest worker hasn't listed its datasets yet.
CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Wait a few seconds and reload.

NOT_PUBLISHABLE.title: This result can't be shown
NOT_PUBLISHABLE.message: It contains per-symbol data that the data provider's terms don't allow us to publish.
NOT_PUBLISHABLE.fix: Open the tearsheet instead, or contact the operator.

UNSAFE_INTEGER.title: A number was too large to show exactly
UNSAFE_INTEGER.message: The server refused to send a value that a browser would round.
UNSAFE_INTEGER.fix: This is a bug; please report it.

ERROR.title: Something went wrong
ERROR.message: The server reported an unexpected error.
ERROR.fix: Try again; if it persists, check the technical details.
